''' Related NPCs: ''' | Giants |} Kindly faction is required for all Thurgadin armor quests.
== Reward == {{Gear Set |Sage's Crown |Sage's Robe |Sage's Sleeves |Sage's Bracelet |Sage's Gloves |Sage's Pantaloons |Sage's Boots }} == Checklist == Turn-ins to [[Mauren Frostbeard]] in [[Thurgadin]].{{CheckboxList}} *[[Sage's Crown]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Turban]] :*3x [[Crushed Flame Opal]] *[[Sage's Robe]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Robe]] :*3x [[Pristine Emerald]] *[[Sage's Sleeves]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Sleeves]] :*3x [[Flawed Topaz]] *[[Sage's Bracelet]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Wristband]] :*3x [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]] *[[Sage's Gloves]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Gloves]] :*3x [[Crushed Topaz]] *[[Sage's Pantaloons]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Pantaloons]] :*3x [[Nephrite]] *[[Sage's Boots]] :*[[Torn Enchanted Silk Boots]] :*3x [[Crushed Jaundice Gem]] {{End}} == Walkthrough == Hail her, and she says "Greetings to you. I seek those who call themselves wizards. Are you a wizard, ____?" You say, 'I am a wizard' She says "I thought so. I have several tasks for you to accomplish. Once you have completed them I will have a cap, a robe, sleeves, wristbands, gloves, leggings, and boots to reward you with." '''After turn-in:''' Mauren Frostbeard smiles warmly as he hands you your reward. 'You have done well, _____.'
* Your faction standing with [[Coldain]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Dain Frostreaver IV]] got better. * Your faction standing with [[Kromzek]] got worse. * Your faction standing with [[Kromrif]] got worse.
{{YouGainExperience}} == Helm == ''Dialogue needed.'' Mauren promises to make you a cap if you bring him a [[Torn Enchanted Silk Turban]] and three pieces of [[Crushed Flame Opal]]. == Robe == You say 'what robe' She says "If you wish to have a fine robe, bring unto me a torn enchanted silk robe and three pristine emeralds. Then you will receive a robe beyond your wildest dreams." Mauren promises to make you a robe if you bring him a [[Torn Enchanted Silk Robe]] and three [[Pristine Emerald]]s. == Sleeves == ''Dialogue needed.'' Mauren promises to make you a sleeves if you bring him a set of [[Torn Enchanted Silk Sleeves]] and three [[Flawed Topaz]]. == Bracer == ''Dialogue needed.'' Mauren promises to make you wristbands if you bring him an [[Torn Enchanted Silk Wristband]] and three [[Crushed Onyx Sapphire]]s. == Gloves == ''Dialogue needed.'' Mauren promises to make you gloves if you bring him a pair of [[Torn Enchanted Silk Gloves]] and three [[Crushed Topaz]]. == Leggings == ''Dialogue needed.'' Mauren promises to make you leggings if you bring him a pair of [[Torn Enchanted Silk Pantaloons]] and three [[Nephrite]]. == Boots == You say 'what boots' She says "Three crushed jaundice gems combined with torn enchanted silk boots would make a most interesting set of footwear. The latent powers of the gems can be harnessed to create magical effects." Mauren promises to make you boots if you bring him [[Torn Enchanted Silk Boots]] and three [[Crushed Jaundice Gem]]s.
